framework.name: ISO/IEC 27001:2022 Annex A
framework.description: ISO/IEC 27001:2022 Annex A — 93 information-security controls organised into Organizational (A.5), People (A.6), Physical (A.7), and Technological (A.8) categories.

domains.name: Organizational
domains.description: A.5 — governance, supplier, incident, continuity, and compliance controls.

domains.name: People
domains.description: A.6 — workforce screening, training, and termination controls.

domains.name: Physical
domains.description: A.7 — physical-perimeter, equipment, and environmental controls.

domains.name: Technological
domains.description: A.8 — access, crypto, network, dev-ops, and operational technical controls.

controls.title: Policies for information security
controls.summary_description: Define, approve, publish, and review information-security policy and topic-specific policies.
controls.implementation_guidance: Maintain a board-approved information security policy with documented review cadence.

suggested_task_templates.title: Review information security policy
suggested_task_templates.description: Confirm policy aligns with current scope and obligations.

controls.title: Information security roles and responsibilities
controls.summary_description: Define and allocate information security roles and responsibilities according to organizational needs.
controls.implementation_guidance: Document RACI for security responsibilities and review on org change.

controls.title: Segregation of duties
controls.summary_description: Conflicting duties and conflicting areas of responsibility shall be segregated.
controls.implementation_guidance: Identify conflicting duties and enforce segregation through role design and approvals.

suggested_task_templates.title: Review SoD coverage
suggested_task_templates.description: Validate SoD enforcement on critical processes.

controls.title: Management responsibilities
controls.summary_description: Management shall require all personnel to apply information security in accordance with established policies and procedures.
controls.implementation_guidance: Reinforce security expectations through onboarding, training, and performance reviews.

suggested_task_templates.title: Confirm management reinforcement
suggested_task_templates.description: Sample staff for awareness of obligations.

controls.title: Contact with authorities
controls.summary_description: The organization shall establish and maintain contact with relevant authorities.
controls.implementation_guidance: Maintain a contact list of relevant regulators and law-enforcement contacts.

controls.title: Contact with special interest groups
controls.summary_description: Establish and maintain contact with special interest groups, security forums, and professional associations.
controls.implementation_guidance: Track memberships and intelligence subscriptions.

controls.title: Threat intelligence
controls.summary_description: Information relating to information security threats shall be collected and analysed to produce threat intelligence.
controls.implementation_guidance: Subscribe to relevant threat feeds; document triage of intelligence.

suggested_task_templates.title: Review threat-intelligence triage
suggested_task_templates.description: Confirm relevance and action on recent intel.

controls.title: Information security in project management
controls.summary_description: Information security shall be integrated into project management.
controls.implementation_guidance: Embed security review gates in the project lifecycle.

suggested_task_templates.title: Review project security gates
suggested_task_templates.description: Confirm gates applied to active projects.

controls.title: Inventory of information and other associated assets
controls.summary_description: An inventory of information and other associated assets, including owners, shall be developed and maintained.
controls.implementation_guidance: Maintain an asset register with ownership and classification metadata.

controls.title: Acceptable use of information and other associated assets
controls.summary_description: Rules for the acceptable use of and procedures for handling information and other associated assets shall be identified, documented, and implemented.
controls.implementation_guidance: Publish an acceptable-use policy; collect annual acknowledgements.

controls.title: Return of assets
controls.summary_description: Personnel and other interested parties shall return all the organization's assets in their possession upon change or termination of their employment, contract, or agreement.
controls.implementation_guidance: Document offboarding asset-return procedures and capture confirmations.

suggested_task_templates.title: Audit asset-return records
suggested_task_templates.description: Sample recent leavers for asset return.

controls.title: Classification of information
controls.summary_description: Information shall be classified according to the information security needs of the organization based on confidentiality, integrity, availability, and relevant interested party requirements.
controls.implementation_guidance: Define classification levels and require classification at creation.

suggested_task_templates.title: Review classification scheme
suggested_task_templates.description: Confirm scheme covers all data types.

controls.title: Labelling of information
controls.summary_description: An appropriate set of procedures for information labelling shall be developed and implemented in accordance with the information classification scheme.
controls.implementation_guidance: Apply labels in tools (DLP tags, header markings) consistent with classification.

controls.title: Information transfer
controls.summary_description: Information transfer rules, procedures, or agreements shall be in place for all types of transfer facilities within the organization and between the organization and other parties.
controls.implementation_guidance: Define approved transfer channels and encryption requirements.

controls.title: Access control
controls.summary_description: Rules to control physical and logical access to information and other associated assets shall be established and implemented based on business and information security requirements.
controls.implementation_guidance: Document an access-control policy aligned with classification and roles.

controls.title: Identity management
controls.summary_description: The full life cycle of identities shall be managed.
controls.implementation_guidance: Operate a single identity provider with provisioning, deprovisioning, and review.

controls.title: Authentication information
controls.summary_description: Allocation and management of authentication information shall be controlled by a management process.
controls.implementation_guidance: Enforce strong password/MFA requirements; rotate secrets per policy.

suggested_task_templates.title: Verify MFA coverage
suggested_task_templates.description: Confirm MFA on all privileged accounts.

controls.title: Access rights
controls.summary_description: Access rights shall be provisioned, reviewed, modified, and removed.
controls.implementation_guidance: Run quarterly access reviews; capture approver decisions.

controls.title: Information security in supplier relationships
controls.summary_description: Processes and procedures shall be defined and implemented to manage the information security risks associated with the use of supplier products or services.
controls.implementation_guidance: Run a vendor risk-assessment workflow; record decisions.

controls.title: Addressing information security within supplier agreements
controls.summary_description: Relevant information security requirements shall be established and agreed with each supplier.
controls.implementation_guidance: Include security clauses (DPA, breach notice) in vendor contracts.

controls.title: Managing information security in the ICT supply chain
controls.summary_description: Processes and procedures shall be defined and implemented to manage the information security risks associated with the ICT products and services supply chain.
controls.implementation_guidance: Inventory ICT supply-chain dependencies; assess and document risks.

controls.title: Monitoring, review and change management of supplier services
controls.summary_description: The organization shall regularly monitor, review, evaluate, and manage change in supplier information security practices and service delivery.
controls.implementation_guidance: Track supplier SLA performance and security posture changes.

suggested_task_templates.title: Review supplier performance
suggested_task_templates.description: Capture review of SLA + security posture.

controls.title: Information security for use of cloud services
controls.summary_description: Processes for acquisition, use, management, and exit from cloud services shall be established.
controls.implementation_guidance: Maintain a cloud-services register and exit/data-portability plans.

controls.title: Information security incident management planning and preparation
controls.summary_description: The organization shall plan and prepare for managing information security incidents.
controls.implementation_guidance: Maintain an IR plan, on-call rota, and tabletop schedule.

controls.title: Assessment and decision on information security events
controls.summary_description: The organization shall assess information security events and decide if they are to be categorized as information security incidents.
controls.implementation_guidance: Define event-to-incident criteria; document classification.

controls.title: Response to information security incidents
controls.summary_description: Information security incidents shall be responded to in accordance with the documented procedures.
controls.implementation_guidance: Operate IR runbooks; capture actions and timing.

controls.title: Learning from information security incidents
controls.summary_description: Knowledge gained from information security incidents shall be used to strengthen and improve information security controls.
controls.implementation_guidance: Conduct post-incident reviews; track remediation through to closure.

controls.title: Collection of evidence
controls.summary_description: The organization shall establish and implement procedures for the identification, collection, acquisition, and preservation of evidence related to information security events.
controls.implementation_guidance: Document forensic evidence procedures; train responders.

controls.title: Information security during disruption
controls.summary_description: The organization shall plan how to maintain information security at an appropriate level during disruption.
controls.implementation_guidance: Document continuity controls (alt access, backups, alt comms).

controls.title: ICT readiness for business continuity
controls.summary_description: ICT readiness shall be planned, implemented, maintained, and tested based on business continuity objectives and ICT continuity requirements.
controls.implementation_guidance: Test ICT recovery against documented RTO/RPO.

controls.title: Legal, statutory, regulatory and contractual requirements
controls.summary_description: Legal, statutory, regulatory, and contractual requirements relevant to information security shall be identified, documented, and kept up to date.
controls.implementation_guidance: Maintain a legal-obligations register with reviews.

controls.title: Intellectual property rights
controls.summary_description: The organization shall implement appropriate procedures to protect intellectual property rights.
controls.implementation_guidance: Track licenses and document ownership of code/content.

controls.title: Protection of records
controls.summary_description: Records shall be protected from loss, destruction, falsification, unauthorized access, and unauthorized release.
controls.implementation_guidance: Define retention/protection rules per record class; verify enforcement.

controls.title: Privacy and protection of PII
controls.summary_description: The organization shall identify and meet the requirements regarding the preservation of privacy and protection of PII.
controls.implementation_guidance: Run a privacy programme aligned with applicable regulations.

controls.title: Independent review of information security
controls.summary_description: The organization's approach to managing information security and its implementation shall be reviewed independently at planned intervals or when significant changes occur.
controls.implementation_guidance: Engage an independent reviewer (internal audit or external) on a planned cycle.

controls.title: Compliance with policies, rules and standards for information security
controls.summary_description: Compliance with the organization's information security policy, topic-specific policies, rules, and standards shall be regularly reviewed.
controls.implementation_guidance: Run continuous-compliance checks; document deviations.

controls.title: Documented operating procedures
controls.summary_description: Operating procedures for information processing facilities shall be documented and made available to personnel who need them.
controls.implementation_guidance: Maintain runbooks for ops procedures; review on change.

controls.title: Screening
controls.summary_description: Background verification checks on all candidates to become personnel shall be carried out prior to joining the organization, and on an ongoing basis as appropriate.
controls.implementation_guidance: Document screening procedures; capture completion records.

controls.title: Terms and conditions of employment
controls.summary_description: The employment contractual agreements shall state the personnel's and the organization's responsibilities for information security.
controls.implementation_guidance: Include security clauses in employment contracts.

suggested_task_templates.title: Review contract clauses
suggested_task_templates.description: Confirm security clauses present in template.

controls.title: Information security awareness, education and training
controls.summary_description: Personnel of the organization and relevant interested parties shall receive appropriate information security awareness, education, and training.
controls.implementation_guidance: Run annual security training; track completion.

controls.title: Disciplinary process
controls.summary_description: A disciplinary process shall be formalized and communicated to take actions against personnel and other relevant interested parties who have committed an information security policy violation.
controls.implementation_guidance: Document disciplinary procedures and communicate them.

controls.title: Responsibilities after termination or change of employment
controls.summary_description: Information security responsibilities and duties that remain valid after termination or change of employment shall be defined, enforced, and communicated to relevant personnel.
controls.implementation_guidance: Capture acknowledgement of post-employment obligations.

controls.title: Confidentiality or non-disclosure agreements
controls.summary_description: Confidentiality or non-disclosure agreements reflecting the organization's needs for the protection of information shall be identified, documented, regularly reviewed, and signed.
controls.implementation_guidance: Maintain NDA template; require execution at onboarding.

suggested_task_templates.title: Audit NDA coverage
suggested_task_templates.description: Confirm NDAs for staff and contractors.

controls.title: Remote working
controls.summary_description: Security measures shall be implemented when personnel are working remotely to protect information accessed, processed, or stored outside the organization's premises.
controls.implementation_guidance: Document remote-working policy; enforce VPN/MDM where applicable.

controls.title: Information security event reporting
controls.summary_description: The organization shall provide a mechanism for personnel to report observed or suspected information security events through appropriate channels in a timely manner.
controls.implementation_guidance: Operate a clear reporting channel; communicate to staff.

controls.title: Physical security perimeters
controls.summary_description: Security perimeters shall be defined and used to protect areas that contain information and other associated assets.
controls.implementation_guidance: If applicable, document perimeter design; otherwise mark NA for cloud-only.

controls.title: Physical entry
controls.summary_description: Secure areas shall be protected by appropriate entry controls and access points.
controls.implementation_guidance: Document entry controls; review badge logs.

controls.title: Securing offices, rooms and facilities
controls.summary_description: Physical security for offices, rooms, and facilities shall be designed and implemented.
controls.implementation_guidance: Document office security controls.

controls.title: Physical security monitoring
controls.summary_description: Premises shall be continuously monitored for unauthorized physical access.
controls.implementation_guidance: Operate alarms/CCTV where applicable; mark NA for cloud-only.

controls.title: Protecting against physical and environmental threats
controls.summary_description: Protection against physical and environmental threats, such as natural disasters and other intentional or unintentional physical threats, shall be designed and implemented.
controls.implementation_guidance: Document environmental controls (fire, flood) where applicable.

controls.title: Working in secure areas
controls.summary_description: Security measures for working in secure areas shall be designed and implemented.
controls.implementation_guidance: If applicable, document procedures for secure areas.

controls.title: Clear desk and clear screen
controls.summary_description: Clear desk rules for papers and removable storage media and clear screen rules for information processing facilities shall be defined and appropriately enforced.
controls.implementation_guidance: Document clear-desk policy; reinforce in training.

controls.title: Equipment siting and protection
controls.summary_description: Equipment shall be sited securely and protected.
controls.implementation_guidance: Document siting requirements where applicable.

controls.title: Security of assets off-premises
controls.summary_description: Off-site assets shall be protected.
controls.implementation_guidance: Define off-premises asset protection (laptops, mobile devices).

controls.title: Storage media
controls.summary_description: Storage media shall be managed through their life cycle of acquisition, use, transportation, and disposal in accordance with the organization's classification scheme and handling requirements.
controls.implementation_guidance: Document media handling/disposal procedures.

controls.title: Supporting utilities
controls.summary_description: Information processing facilities shall be protected from power failures and other disruptions caused by failures in supporting utilities.
controls.implementation_guidance: Document UPS/redundancy where applicable; mark NA for fully managed cloud.

controls.title: Cabling security
controls.summary_description: Cables carrying power, data, or supporting information services shall be protected from interception, interference, or damage.
controls.implementation_guidance: Document cabling protections where applicable.

controls.title: Equipment maintenance
controls.summary_description: Equipment shall be maintained correctly to ensure availability, integrity, and confidentiality of information.
controls.implementation_guidance: Document maintenance schedules; track completion.

controls.title: Secure disposal or re-use of equipment
controls.summary_description: Items of equipment containing storage media shall be verified to ensure that any sensitive data and licensed software has been removed or securely overwritten prior to disposal or re-use.
controls.implementation_guidance: Verify wipe/disposal certificates for retired hardware.

controls.title: User end point devices
controls.summary_description: Information stored on, processed by, or accessible via user end point devices shall be protected.
controls.implementation_guidance: Enforce MDM, encryption, and update policies on managed devices.

controls.title: Privileged access rights
controls.summary_description: The allocation and use of privileged access rights shall be restricted and managed.
controls.implementation_guidance: Restrict privileged access; require break-glass approvals; log usage.

suggested_task_templates.title: Review privileged-access usage
suggested_task_templates.description: Sample privileged-access events for approval evidence.

controls.title: Information access restriction
controls.summary_description: Access to information and other associated assets shall be restricted in accordance with the established topic-specific policy on access control.
controls.implementation_guidance: Enforce least privilege; review access by classification.

controls.title: Access to source code
controls.summary_description: Read and write access to source code, development tools, and software libraries shall be appropriately managed.
controls.implementation_guidance: Require approvals for repo access; enforce branch protection and reviews.

controls.title: Secure authentication
controls.summary_description: Secure authentication technologies and procedures shall be implemented based on information access restrictions and the topic-specific policy on access control.
controls.implementation_guidance: Require MFA, passwordless or strong-password where applicable.

suggested_task_templates.title: Verify auth strength
suggested_task_templates.description: Confirm MFA coverage on critical apps.

controls.title: Capacity management
controls.summary_description: The use of resources shall be monitored and adjusted in line with current and expected capacity requirements.
controls.implementation_guidance: Monitor resource utilisation; alert on capacity thresholds.

controls.title: Protection against malware
controls.summary_description: Protection against malware shall be implemented and supported by appropriate user awareness.
controls.implementation_guidance: Operate EDR on managed devices; awareness training.

suggested_task_templates.title: Review malware protections
suggested_task_templates.description: Confirm EDR coverage and training currency.

controls.title: Management of technical vulnerabilities
controls.summary_description: Information about technical vulnerabilities of information systems in use shall be obtained, the organization's exposure to such vulnerabilities shall be evaluated, and appropriate measures shall be taken.
controls.implementation_guidance: Run vulnerability scans; track remediation SLAs.

controls.title: Configuration management
controls.summary_description: Configurations, including security configurations, of hardware, software, services, and networks shall be established, documented, implemented, monitored, and reviewed.
controls.implementation_guidance: Maintain IaC baselines; detect drift.

controls.title: Information deletion
controls.summary_description: Information stored in information systems, devices, or in any other storage media shall be deleted when no longer required.
controls.implementation_guidance: Operate retention/purge jobs; verify replicas and backups.

controls.title: Data masking
controls.summary_description: Data masking shall be used in accordance with the topic-specific policy on access control and other related topic-specific policies, and business requirements, taking applicable legislation into consideration.
controls.implementation_guidance: Mask PII in non-production environments.

controls.title: Data leakage prevention
controls.summary_description: Data leakage prevention measures shall be applied to systems, networks, and any other devices that process, store, or transmit sensitive information.
controls.implementation_guidance: Operate DLP rules at egress and on managed devices.

controls.title: Information backup
controls.summary_description: Backup copies of information, software, and systems shall be maintained and regularly tested in accordance with the agreed-upon topic-specific policy on backup.
controls.implementation_guidance: Document backup schedule; test restores periodically.

controls.title: Redundancy of information processing facilities
controls.summary_description: Information processing facilities shall be implemented with redundancy sufficient to meet availability requirements.
controls.implementation_guidance: Document multi-AZ/region redundancy for critical services.

controls.title: Logging
controls.summary_description: Logs that record activities, exceptions, faults, and other relevant events shall be produced, stored, protected, and analysed.
controls.implementation_guidance: Centralise logs in a tamper-evident store; retain per policy.

suggested_task_templates.title: Review logging coverage
suggested_task_templates.description: Confirm critical sources stream to SIEM.

controls.title: Monitoring activities
controls.summary_description: Networks, systems, and applications shall be monitored for anomalous behaviour, and appropriate actions shall be taken to evaluate potential information security incidents.
controls.implementation_guidance: Tune detections; document triage.

controls.title: Clock synchronization
controls.summary_description: The clocks of information processing systems used by the organization shall be synchronized to approved time sources.
controls.implementation_guidance: Use NTP/PTP; monitor drift.

controls.title: Use of privileged utility programs
controls.summary_description: The use of utility programs that can be capable of overriding system and application controls shall be restricted and tightly controlled.
controls.implementation_guidance: Restrict use of privileged utilities; log invocations.

controls.title: Installation of software on operational systems
controls.summary_description: Procedures and measures shall be implemented to securely manage software installation on operational systems.
controls.implementation_guidance: Restrict software installation through allow-listing or change control.

controls.title: Networks security
controls.summary_description: Networks and network devices shall be secured, managed, and controlled to protect information in systems and applications.
controls.implementation_guidance: Manage firewall rules; segment networks.

controls.title: Security of network services
controls.summary_description: Security mechanisms, service levels, and service requirements of network services shall be identified, implemented, and monitored.
controls.implementation_guidance: Document network services and their security mechanisms.

controls.title: Segregation of networks
controls.summary_description: Groups of information services, users, and information systems shall be segregated in the organization's networks.
controls.implementation_guidance: Enforce VPC/subnet segregation between environments.

controls.title: Web filtering
controls.summary_description: Access to external websites shall be managed to reduce exposure to malicious content.
controls.implementation_guidance: Operate web-filtering on managed networks/devices.

controls.title: Use of cryptography
controls.summary_description: Rules for the effective use of cryptography, including cryptographic key management, shall be defined and implemented.
controls.implementation_guidance: Document approved algorithms; manage keys via KMS.

suggested_task_templates.title: Review crypto policy
suggested_task_templates.description: Confirm algorithm choices and key rotation.

controls.title: Secure development life cycle
controls.summary_description: Rules for the secure development of software and systems shall be established and applied.
controls.implementation_guidance: Define SDLC stages with security gates.

controls.title: Application security requirements
controls.summary_description: Information security requirements shall be identified, specified, and approved when developing or acquiring applications.
controls.implementation_guidance: Capture security requirements per application; track approval.

controls.title: Secure system architecture and engineering principles
controls.summary_description: Principles for engineering secure systems shall be established, documented, maintained, and applied to any information system development activities.
controls.implementation_guidance: Adopt secure-by-default architecture principles; train engineers.

controls.title: Secure coding
controls.summary_description: Secure coding principles shall be applied to software development.
controls.implementation_guidance: Adopt secure-coding standards; train engineers; enforce via reviews.

controls.title: Security testing in development and acceptance
controls.summary_description: Security testing processes shall be defined and implemented in the development life cycle.
controls.implementation_guidance: Run SAST/DAST/SCA in CI; gate releases on critical findings.

controls.title: Outsourced development
controls.summary_description: The organization shall direct, monitor, and review the activities related to outsourced system development.
controls.implementation_guidance: Document outsourced-dev oversight; require security clauses.

controls.title: Separation of development, test and production environments
controls.summary_description: Development, testing, and production environments shall be separated and secured.
controls.implementation_guidance: Enforce environment separation in cloud config; restrict cross-env access.

controls.title: Change management
controls.summary_description: Changes to information processing facilities and information systems shall be subject to change management procedures.
controls.implementation_guidance: Operate change-management process with approvals and rollback plans.

controls.title: Test information
controls.summary_description: Test information shall be appropriately selected, protected, and managed.
controls.implementation_guidance: Use synthetic or masked data in test environments; control access.

suggested_task_templates.title: Review test data handling
suggested_task_templates.description: Confirm masking or synthetic data in test.

controls.title: Protection of information systems during audit testing
controls.summary_description: Audit tests and other assurance activities involving assessment of operational systems shall be planned and agreed between the tester and appropriate management.
controls.implementation_guidance: Coordinate audit testing with operations to avoid disruption.
